blind_prompt_review.consensus: The skill prompt expresses obsession as one target-directed incident with affect contrast and an already-visible consequence; the baseline relies mainly on stare, rose, locket, and syringe symbolism.

blind_pixel_review.consensus: Strong face resemblance, nurse and syringe legibility, composition, and photographic finish; the visible result reads as a glamorous or ominous nurse portrait because the nurse does not visibly move the call button and the chart grip does not clearly show the intended possessive affect leak.

assessment.overall_trial_conclusion: The skill materially improved behavior-led prompt semantics and delivered the only image in this one-attempt trial, but it did not make the defining relationship action survive rendering.

limitations: Only one stochastic image call was allowed per arm.
The baseline output moderation block prevents a paired pixel-quality comparison.
A moderation difference in one pair does not establish that the skill caused higher delivery reliability.
The skill prompt assigned the two available hands to the syringe and chart while also describing movement of the call button, creating a physical-action ambiguity not caught by preflight audit.
